verdicts.reason: A keeps a clean vertical stack, but the CTA has shrunk to a tiny pill in the top-right corner sitting on the circle, so it is buried. The stat order is shuffled, the tagline has dropped below the stats, and the legal line is set as large as body copy. B is broken: the stats are scattered across the whole canvas ('40 h' and 'BT 5.4' crammed around the tagline above the headline, '-38 dB' under the CTA, '6 mics' at the very bottom). The tagline sits above its own headline and the small text sits on the circle graphic, so there is no grouping and no reading order.
